title: Minimum Time to Type Word Using Special Typewriter
summary: Given a string word, you can move a pointer on a circle of lowercase English letters 'a' to 'z' either clockwise or counterclockwise each second, or type the letter the pointer is currently on.
statement: Given a string word, you can move a pointer on a circle of lowercase English letters 'a' to 'z' either clockwise or counterclockwise each second, or type the letter the pointer is currently on. Determine the minimum number of seconds required to type out all the characters in the word.
constraints: word contains 1 through 100 lowercase English letters.
The pointer begins at a on a circular alphabet; each clockwise or counterclockwise step costs one second.
Typing the current letter costs one second; return the minimum total time.
reference_solution:
def minimum_typewriter_time(word):
    position = 0
    answer = len(word)
    for char in word:
        target = ord(char) - ord('a')
        distance = abs(target - position)
        answer += min(distance, 26 - distance)
        position = target
    return answer

hints: Between consecutive letters only their circular distance matters.
For alphabet indices x and y, add min(abs(x-y),26-abs(x-y)), then one for typing.
Start at index zero; accumulate circular movement and word length.
Each move is independent and the two directions have complementary lengths, so choosing the shorter direction at every step is globally optimal.
